direction: original dashboard icons with Tumblr-2017-inspired restraint, no logo copying

icons.concept: Brand/app mark. A custom abstract MA-adjacent monogram is allowed, but it must be original and not literal text-heavy: a bold archive tray shape holding two stacked media cards, forming a memorable blocky mark through negative space.
Gallery view. A confident four-tile media grid with one lifted tile and a tiny indexing notch, like a curated visual wall for saved media.
Search view. A bold magnifier fused with one media card and three small semantic match nodes, meaning search by vibe and meaning rather than plain text.
Two source media cards at left and right fold inward through one controlled angular sparkle/prism into a single generated card at the bottom center. Clean synthesis, minimal burst, not chaotic.

Two small source thumbnail cards branch through clean thin trace lines into one final generated card. Use the same off-white field and dark outline language as the gallery/search icons. Emphasize provenance and lineage.
